transcript.content: Hello, it’s nice to meet you. What brings you in today?
I've been feeling extremely depressed, sad, and empty inside for about seven months now. I've completely lost my motivation and just don't have any interest in the things I used to enjoy anymore.
Did these feelings start after a specific stressful event or major life change, or did they come on without a clear trigger?
I don't recall any specific event or change that triggered how I feel. It just seemed to develop gradually over time, and I slowly started feeling worse and worse.
Before these past seven months, had you been feeling down or depressed most days for at least two years, even if it was milder than now?
No, I don't recall feeling down or depressed for a long period like that before this started. Before these past seven months, I think my mood was pretty normal.
During these seven months, have you also had changes in your sleep, appetite, energy, concentration, or feelings of worthlessness or guilt?

I haven't really experienced any changes in my sleep, appetite, energy, or concentration, and I don't feel guilty or worthless. Instead, I just feel constantly sad and empty, with absolutely no motivation or interest in anything for these past seven months.
Have you had any thoughts that life isn’t worth living, or thoughts of hurting yourself or ending your life?
No, I haven't had any thoughts of hurting myself or ending my life. Even though I feel incredibly empty and sad, I don't feel like life isn't worth living.
How much have these symptoms affected your daily life, like work, school, relationships, or taking care of yourself?

I have completely lost all motivation to do my work or even basic daily tasks. I've also been pulling away from my friends and family, feeling totally withdrawn from all my relationships for the past seven months.
Have you ever had a period lasting several days when you felt unusually energetic or euphoric, needed much less sleep, talked much more than usual, or felt your thoughts were racing?
No, I have never experienced anything like that. My mood has been very low and empty, and I've never had periods of high energy or racing thoughts.
Have you started any new medications, used alcohol or drugs more than usual, or had any medical problems around the time these symptoms began?
No, I haven't started any new medications, and I don't use alcohol or drugs. I also don't have any other medical problems that began around the time my depression started.
During these seven months, have there been at least two weeks in a row when you felt depressed or lost interest nearly every day most of the day?

Yes, absolutely. For the entire seven months, I have felt depressed and lost interest in almost everything nearly every single day. It hasn't just been for two weeks; it has been constant this whole time.
Before this seven-month period, were there any stretches of at least two months when you were completely free of depressive symptoms?
I'm not really sure, and I can't quite recall if I had specific symptom-free periods before this started. It is hard to remember exactly how my mood was before these seven months.
